name: Vahlarriel's Search
summary: In Desolace, Vahlarriel's Search follows a trail south from the Malems' wagon. A pendant lies there, and smoke rises from a large fort in the distance. At Nijel's Point, Vahlarriel Demonslayer needs the pendant and word that the Malems may still be alive.

sections.title: Signs of Life
sections.body: You find a pendant in the Malems' wagon and footprints leading south. Smoke rises from a large fort in the distance. A tended fire feeds it, rather than burning buildings. If the Malems are alive, the tracks suggest they were taken toward the fort.

sections.title: Word for Vahlarriel
sections.body: At Nijel's Point, Vahlarriel Demonslayer needs to see the Malem Pendant. Tell her about the footprints leading south.

sections.title: What the Locals Say
sections.body: Vahlarriel is furious. The Malems were warned how dangerous Desolace is, and now both are missing or worse. Tracks toward the nearby fort offer the best lead. Locals say the fortress is overrun by the Burning Blade, orcs devoted to demonic causes. They do not speak for most of the Horde, yet they are evil. Anyone caught spying on them will be killed on sight.

faq.q: What did you find in the wagon?
faq.answer: You find a pendant in the wagon and footprints leading south. Smoke rises from a large fort in the distance.
The tracks lead south toward a large fort. Smoke above it comes from a tended fire, not burning buildings. If the Malems are alive, they may have been taken that way.

aliases: where to turn in malem pendant
faq.answer: Vahlarriel Demonslayer is at Nijel's Point in Desolace. Bring the pendant and news of the tracks there.
